## Gelatinous Golem (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
 N Large construct  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +19  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 24, touch 10, flat-footed 23 (+1 Dex, +14 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 173 (13d10+30 plus 13)  
 **Fort** +6; **Ref** +7; **Will** +6  
 **DR** 10/bludgeoning and magic; **Immune** construct traits, electricity, magic  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 slams +19 (2d6+6 plus 2d6 acid and paralysis)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** acid, engulf, paralysis (3d6 rounds, DC 16)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 22, **Dex** 12, Con—, **Int** 3, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 1  
 **Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 26  
 **Feats** Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (slam), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Perception +19  
 **SQ** transparent  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Acid (Ex)** A gelatinous golem’s acid does not harm metal or stone.  
 
 **Engulf (Ex)** A gelatinous golem can try to wrap an opponent up to one size smaller than itself in its body as a standard action. The gelatinous golem attempts a grapple that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If it wins the grapple the gelatinous golem establishes a hold. Attacks that hit an engulfing gelatinous golem deal half their damage to the golem and half to the engulfed victim.
